scientific_integrity: Proof distinguishes original full-fiber/complex identification from established abstract homotopy and graph-visibility theorems; no independence or publication priority beyond checked sources claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact complex identification applies to connected finite simple base graphs with at least two vertices and clique fibers of size at least two; nonclique substitutions are not treated. The integral homotopy formula invokes the prior 2013 composition theorem. The general distance-two criterion and scalar lexicographic-product formula are prior work. Unindexed equivalent formulations remain a priority risk. Finite computations do not establish the general theorem.
title: Total-visibility complexes of clique substitutions are iterated simplicial wedges
